resolution.note: Stop hook accepts a lane whose ship merged and removed its branch: ship records the merge under .krn/runs/ship; test builds a real repo, merges, removes worktree and branch, runs judgeStop

title: The Stop hook treats a merged ship of the lane's branch as done
body:
Why: almost every lane on 2026-11-15 (t-y6vrqh7, t-f5bfhd0, t-a3dsm8g, t-1dtcrj8, t-vpvn2pv, t-65nnfyp, t-9e...) hit the Stop hook complaining about a missing commit after krn pr ship had merged and deleted the branch and worktree; lanes then spent turns explaining (final replies start 'the branch was deleted after merge, so the hook sees no commit').
Outcome: the Stop hook (src/hook/stop.ts and the lane/worktree resolution it uses) treats a lane whose branch was shipped and merged (ship verdict 'verdict: merged <sha>' for that branch, or the branch's PR merged on origin) as done and allows Stop without a commit on the deleted branch.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/hook/session.ts, the ship verdict record if one is needed.
Proof: a regression test at the lowest layer: a session whose worktree/branch was removed after a merged ship is allowed to stop; a session with no ship and no commit is still refused.
